items.html: And this is the matter of her correction and enlargement: at first, from the aspect of the Achoraim of the Netzah, Hod, and Yesod of ZA, three mochin — Hochma, Bina, and Daat — were made in her. But it is known that all the measure of her stature is the measure of the length from his Chazeh downward. And it is that his thighs divide into joints, as is known, so that from his Tifferet, from the Chazeh downward, her Keter was made; and from the back of his NNH, all her ten Sefirot were made, from her Hochma to her Malchut, as is known to us.
